description: This file defines types, constants, structures, and function prototypes for Wi-Fi hardware abstraction layer (HAL) capabilities, including device info, security, radio, and client statistics, as well as Wi-Fi operations like initialization, reset, and configuration.

methods.name: wifi_getHalCapability
methods.description: Retrieves the features and configuration supported by the Wi-Fi HAL.

methods.name: wifi_factoryReset
methods.description: Performs a factory reset of the Wi-Fi subsystem, resetting internal variables.

methods.name: wifi_setLED
methods.description: Sets the system LED status for a specified radio index.

methods.name: wifi_reset
methods.description: Resets the Wi-Fi subsystem, including all access point variables.

methods.name: wifi_down
methods.description: Turns off transmit power for the entire Wi-Fi subsystem.

methods.name: wifi_createInitialConfigFiles
methods.description: Creates Wi-Fi configuration files as needed.

methods.name: wifi_createHostApdConfig
methods.description: Creates configuration variables needed for WPA/WPS for a specified access point.

methods.name: wifi_startHostApd
methods.description: Starts hostapd with the current configuration.
